title: Preserve the VOX final preview checkpoint
description: Keep voice, subtitle, and timeline stages automatic while leaving the real preview render at the required needs_review final-preview checkpoint.
businessContext: The resumed VOX runtime now produces voice, subtitles, timeline, and a real preview, but the production orchestrator auto-approves preview-render. The simplified UI therefore cannot present or approve the required Final Preview checkpoint and cannot continue to packaging through the intended user action.
acceptanceCriteria: Voice Generation, Subtitle Preparation, and Timeline Assembly remain automatically approved when valid.
Preview Render remains needs_review after automatic rendering and no approve-preview handler is invoked by the orchestrator.
The existing Final Preview approval path can continue to QA and Packaging Export after explicit user approval.
Focused orchestrator tests, typecheck, and diff checks pass without claiming final export evidence.
humanEscalationConditions: Preserving the checkpoint requires changing the preview IPC contract outside the orchestrator boundary.
